name: Mogadishu (Somalia)
description: A field divided diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist, red above and blue below, charged at the centre with the arms of Banaadir: a shield bearing a lighthouse, flanked by green wreaths.
history: The flag of the Banaadir Regional Administration, which governs Mogadishu, was first reported in 2020; its arms show the city's lighthouse. Reports differ on the direction of the diagonal, and no adoption date has been published.

features.role: arms with the Mogadishu lighthouse and a blue star
